'''Makoto Higo''' (Japanese: '''肥後誠''' ''Higo Makoto'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Higo was born on June 1, 1971, in {{wp|Shimane Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He first provided the voice of Kai, one of the [[Invincible Pokémon Brothers]], during {{aniseries|GS}}, as well as [[Pokémon Chronicles]]. He then provided a couple more voices during {{aniseries|RS}}, most notably that of [[Sid]] in [[M07|the seventh movie]]. Higo was affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production, but is now with KeKKe Corporation.
